_meta.title: Ceiling DNA Library
_meta.purpose: Ten curated ceiling configurations spanning the design space — sterile to industrial, liminal to clinical. Each entry is a complete `ceiling` block ready to drop into any map's `settings`. Mix preset (tile/light/grid scheme) with fixture preset (vents/sprinklers/sensors/speakers/panels). Same seed (42) across all entries so you can compare LAYOUT differences between mixes; bump the seed if you want a different distribution.

sterile_quarantine.blurb: Medical-grade quarantine chamber. Few visible vents, many smoke sensors, no speakers. Bright cool light, low ceiling. Reads as 'something is being watched here'.

research_balanced.blurb: Standard university lab. Balanced mix — a couple of each fixture, regular light spacing. The neutral baseline; everything else is a deviation from this.

industrial_warehouse.blurb: High ceiling, harsh sparse lights, ventilation everywhere. Reads as storage / manufacturing / loading bay. No speakers, no decorative panels — purely functional.

liminal_dim.blurb: Backrooms / 3am institution. Sparse low light, a single distant speaker. Most fixtures absent — the emptiness IS the texture. Use for unsettling transitional spaces.

broadcast_studio.blurb: PA-heavy announcement space. Many overhead speakers, accent panels for dramatic light. Reads as airport gate / lecture hall / control room.

emergency_corridor.blurb: Fire-safety regs gone wild. Sprinklers + sensors everywhere, harsh bright light, low ceiling. Use for hazard zones, evacuation routes, the moment-before-disaster.

clinical_clean.blurb: Hospital / clinic. Many sensors (CO2, smoke, motion), measured sprinkler coverage, soft speakers for paging. High light density for surgical brightness.

server_room.blurb: Datacenter cold aisle. Maximum vents (cooling), heavy sprinklers (one fault and the whole rack burns), no speakers, no decoration. Functional only.

gallery_showroom.blurb: Museum-grade exhibition. Sparse functional fixtures, many accent light panels for dramatic art lighting. Calm. Reads as 'observe carefully'.

maintenance_zone.blurb: Utility / mechanical room. Exposed vents, occasional sprinkler, single sensor, no decoration. Sparse harsh light. The unseen backside of the lab.
